items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I know him good. He was the uncle of my friend.

ctx.x: Abe Buller, what trumpet player? What about him? Abe? Bully. Bully. From Baton Rouge. From Baton Rouge. From Baton Rouge. Oh, that's when I chose to play with the Hill City Bears. East Flat. East Flat Cornet. I wasn't playing with him today. Then when I went to Baton Rouge, after I got older, I know him good. He was the uncle of my friend. We'd come up together, you know. That's why I know all them fathers in Baton Rouge.
Ask him what his name is.
